notes.title: The Combat Racers comic is here!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Leevi from the Major Game Company here. In the middle of our current projects, we haven't forgotten about Combat Racers either. And as proof we have just now released the first Combat Racers comic.

The comic serves to give a little bit of idea what the game is like to players, and we will make it publicly available on our website soon.

For now, if you wish to read the comic, it's available as the manual for Combat Racers, which you can view after downloading the game.

We hope you enjoy reading the short-comic, and hope to hear your feedback of it.

-Leevi

notes.title: Update to version 1.0.1 (patch)
notes.content:
[h1]Complete changelog[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed certain achievements and stats not updating correctly
[*]Fixed in-game music being too loud
[*]Made the text in how to play menu easier to read
[*]Centered the audio sliders and the text is also highlighted when selected
[*]Added a version text in options screen
[*]Removed some debugging tools
[/list]
